sourceBindings.text: A handful of soil gives an estimate, not an instrument reading. Describe what the sample actually shows, then learn what each drip-line part does before assembling and testing a one-metre line under a trainer's supervision.

Personally take a sample from the trainer-designated active root zone, record its depth and observable feel/appearance, and interpret moisture in light of texture without reporting an unmeasured percentage or a prewritten 'too dry' answer.

Name the tubing, three compatible emitters, punch, end cap, connector, upstream filter and any kit-required pressure-control parts; explain their functions and the safe assembly/test order using the actual kit guide.
Under trainer supervision personally assemble a one-metre line with three plant-aligned emitters, then check seating, leaks and output with the compatible kit and clean the work area.

sourceBindings.text: For a recorded sand, loam or clay sample, choose observations and a qualified moisture judgment; say what more you would inspect in the root zone.
Place tubing, punch, three emitters, end cap, connector, filter and kit-specific pressure controls in the setup and match each to its role.
Rehearse measuring, marking, punching, seating, sealing, connecting and testing in a labelled 3D simulation. Identify a leak and blocked outlet and the safe correction order.
A texture-independent ball rule or asserted percentage gets a focused explanation and retry; rehearsal never passes C01.
Online checks prepare understanding only. Sampling and assembly remain unobserved until a trainer records the individual physical evidence; no signature, score or pass is prefilled.

sourceBindings.text: root zone
The soil depth and locations actively explored by the crop's roots under the current field conditions.
feel and appearance
An observational estimate of soil-water condition using touch, color, balling, ribboning and staining interpreted for texture.
sandy loam
A loamy texture with a substantial sand fraction; its balling behaviour must be judged with a texture-specific guide.
drip emitter
A compatible small outlet that releases water near the intended plant position.
filter
A component that removes particles from supplied irrigation water to reduce blockages, selected for the kit and water quality.
pressure control
Kit-specified parts or checks that keep operating pressure within the chosen product's limits.
functional line
An assembled line shown in a safe controlled test to deliver through all intended emitters without observed leaks.
